question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Livid
solution:
The correct answer is 'Furious'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Livid is an adjective that means furiously angry.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Closed - not open.
 
• **Pale **- light in color or shade; containing little color or pigment.
 
• Furious - extremely angry.
 
• Clear - easy to perceive, understand or interpret.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is evident that **furious **is the correct synonym for the word livid.
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

 
• **Pale means light in color or shade; containing little color or pigment OR inferior or unimpressive. This can be the correct answer but the most appropriate is *Option 3 i.e. Furious as this is the exact meaning of the given word.***
